szene: In an open-plan office, Resi stands calmly in front of a jammed office printer with a red error light, holding one crumpled sheet of paper, deadpan. Herbert sits on top of the printer peering into the paper tray.

At a Vienna Christmas market at night, Resi stands at a wooden punch stand holding a steaming mug with both hands, warm fairy lights and blurred crowds behind her, she looks unimpressed. Herbert sits on the rim of her mug sniffing the steam.

In a small apartment bathroom, Resi sits cross-legged on the floor in front of a running washing machine, watching the drum spin as if it were television. Herbert hangs upside down from the towel rail next to her head.

Late at night on a dark velvet sofa, Resi is wrapped in a black blanket up to her chin, her face lit by her phone screen, deadpan. Herbert is tucked into the blanket next to her face, also looking at the phone.
In a Vienna U-Bahn station, Resi stands perfectly still on the right side of a long escalator going up while blurred people rush past on the left. Herbert sits on her shoulder, equally calm.
